name: Open GAO Recommendations: Financial Benefits Could Be Between $132 Billion and $251 Billion
known_limitations: The $132 billion to $251 billion range is a modeled government-wide potential-benefit estimate as of October 2025. It is not a forecast, budget score, agency allocation, or realized saving, and actual benefits depend on whether, how, and when recommendations are implemented. Phase 56O preserves portfolio arithmetic, scope, status period, method, and continuation boundaries.
